examples.claim: Existing systems waste 60%-80% of memory through fragmentation and over-reservation
examples.source: Blog: 'existing systems waste 60% – 80% of memory due to fragmentation and over-reservation.'

examples.claim: PagedAttention waste only in the last block, under 4%
examples.source: Blog: 'memory waste only happens in the last block of a sequence ... a mere waste of under 4%.'

examples.claim: Run:ai concludes the generation phase is memory-bound
examples.source: Run:ai Discussion: 'makes the generation process memory-bound rather than compute-bound.'

examples.claim: 600 tokens used of a 4,096-token reservation leaves about 85% unused
Authors set default block size 16 from ShareGPT/Alpaca measurements; large enough for GPU use, small enough to limit fragmentation; scoped to the paper's vLLM
examples.source: Paper §7.2: 'the block size 16 is large enough to efficiently utilize the GPU and small enough to avoid significant internal fragmentation in most workloads.'

examples.claim: Llama 3.1 8B (32 layers, 8 KV heads, 128 dim, FP16) uses 131,072 bytes (128KB) per token, 16GB at 131,072 tokens; a 16-token block is 2MB
examples.source: Fastio: 'Bytes per Token = 2 * 32 * 8 * 128 * 2 = 131,072 bytes (128 KB)'; '131,072 tokens: ... sixteen gigabytes'; 16 x 128KB = 2MB.

examples.claim: --prefix-caching-hash-algo choices sha256, sha256_cbor, xxhash, xxhash_cbor, default sha256; xxhash needs the optional package; collision risk can leak data in multi-tenant setups
examples.source: vllm/config/cache.py PrefixCachingHashAlgo literal and docstring; flag parsed ('xxhash_cbor' accepted).

examples.claim: 480-token system prompt at block size 16 = 30 reusable blocks; a leading timestamp breaks all 30
examples.source: Writer example; 480/16 = 30; packet.ai: variable content ahead of the static prompt 'breaks the prefix match immediately'.

examples.claim: V1 alpha: up to 1.7x V0 throughput (V0 without multi-step scheduling); kernels nearly identical; lacked log probs, PP, structured/speculative decoding, Prometheus metrics, LoRA; Ampere+ only
examples.source: V1 blog: 'up to 1.7x higher throughput compared to V0 (without multi-step scheduling)'; feature-gap and 'only Ampere or later' paragraphs.

examples.claim: Server listens on http://localhost:8000, hosts one model at a time; early blog used python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server --model
examples.source: Quickstart Online Serving paragraph; blog: '$ python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server --model lmsys/vicuna-7b-v1.3'.
